text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On a day off from our relentless preparation for the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I happen to pass by the training track and see Special Week doing some independent training with a friend.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I did it… A personal best!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Pant… Phew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Seiun Sky, one of Special Week's classmates. She's a calm and gentle Umamusume who can be very incisive at times.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gosh, I got toasted out there. You've really improved, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You haven't just gotten faster. You've gotten better at racing in general.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really?! Coming from a tactician like you, that's a real honor!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I think running in the Kisaragi Sho was a great help. Lately, it feels like I've finally started to understand how to really run!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I can see the difference. Your form is really shaping up as you get ready for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Oh well. I guess I can't just sit around and do nothing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it, Sei?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking that I've gotta give it my all too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, thanks for running with me today. See ya around!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay! See you in class!
choice_data_list: Hey, Spe! That was some nice running.
Hey, Spe! That was some nice running.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, hey Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I buy Special Week a drink to reward her for the extra training she put in.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp… Ahhh! Talk about hitting the spot!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No. I mean, not just for the juice… but also for training me every day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I did good in the Kisaragi Sho, and I really think I've improved a lot!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'd been running on my own out in the country until I got here, so I didn't have much proper experience. Made me really nervous a lot…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I've gained so much confidence because of what you've been teaching me every day!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Your spirits are as lofty as the clouds above, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Symboli Rudolf, the president of the Tracen Academy student council and an extremely talented Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, P-president! Uhhh, hi!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There is no need for such formalities. My apologies for interrupting your sprightly chat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I just had to come over here and offer the both of you my praise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes. Special Week's meteoric rise as of late has been quite impressive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I believe this to be due to her constant efforts, as well as the persistent encouragement that you give her as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: When I'm surrounded by the pack with my way forward blocked and I've got no stamina left… I imagine Trainer's face…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then my legs fill right back up with energy again! I can keep on pushing because I know I'm not alone!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm… A runner dashing across the turf towards glory, and a trainer to act as her pillar of support. Truly, an ideal pairing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In other matters, I hear that your next goal is the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's a race I've definitely gotta to win if I wanna be the top Umamusume in all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. That is an excellent goal. Special Week, I hope that you…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And your trainer both come out of that race triumphant.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're even wishing Trainer well?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They say that becoming the trainer of a Derby champion is more difficult a task than becoming the leader of a nation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you wish to repay your trainer for all of his trust and devotion, then…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you wish to repay your trainer for all of her trust and devotion, then…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There is no place more suitable than the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the day becomes evening, we part ways with Symboli Rudolf, and I see Special Week back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, nothing! Nope, nothing to see here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks for walking me back to my dorm! I'll see ya tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch as she trods away, consumed in thought.
